title: Paddle Dryer

introduction.definition: A paddle dryer is an indirect (conduction) dryer: two hollow shafts carrying wedge-shaped paddles turn inside a steam-jacketed trough. Steam or thermal oil inside the jacket, shafts and paddles heats the material, while the paddles mix and convey it towards the outlet weir. Only a small vapour stream leaves.
key_points: Large heated surface per volume (shafts + paddles + jacket)
Material never touches the heating medium
introduction.summary: A paddle dryer is an indirect (contact) dryer. Two hollow shafts with wedge-shaped paddles turn in a jacketed trough; steam inside the jacket, shafts and paddles heats the material, while the paddles mix it and move it towards the outlet. Only a small vapour stream leaves, making it suitable for sludges and pastes.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Drying rate falls as material passes the sticky phase and the falling-rate period; residence time set by weir and fill.

temperature.title: Indirect heating through jacket and paddles
temperature.description: Steam (or thermal oil) heats the trough jacket and the inside of the hollow shafts and paddles, so the heating surface per unit volume is very large. The material never touches the heating medium, and only a small vapour stream leaves — easy to condense or treat. Used for sludges, pastes and filter cakes.

video_tutorials.title: Paddle Dryer — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Paddle Dryer.
A paddle dryer is an indirect (conduction) dryer: two hollow shafts carrying wedge-shaped paddles turn inside a steam-jacketed trough.
Steam or thermal oil inside the jacket, shafts and paddles heats the material, while the paddles mix and convey it towards the outlet weir.
Only a small vapour stream leaves.
Typical applications include sewage and industrial sludge drying; pastes and filter cakes; chemicals needing closed, solvent-recovery drying.

The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Jacketed W-Trough (steam jacket), Hollow Shaft 1 with Wedge Paddles (steam inside), Hollow Shaft 2 with Wedge Paddles (steam inside), Cover / Vapour Dome, Vapour Outlet & Feed Inlet.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Paddle Dryer works.
Wet feed enters at one end.
Steam heats the jacketed trough.
The hollow paddle shafts, also steam-heated, mix and convey the material.
Rotary joints feed steam into the turning shafts.
Dried product leaves over the outlet weir; vapour leaves the dome.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Steam (or thermal oil) heats the trough jacket and the inside of the hollow shafts and paddles, so the heating surface per unit volume is very large.

video_tutorials.title: Paddle Dryer — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Paddle Dryer.
Check drive current, steam pressure and condensate removal.
Inspect rotary joints and seals.
Inspect paddles for wear; repair hard-facing.
Watch for overload in sticky phase: high torque, trips. Common cause: wet feed concentration.
Watch for rotary joint leakage: steam leaks. Common cause: seal wear.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
